t: Hex-plus L-key set with holding function and ‘Take it Easy’ tool finder and colour-coded system. The long arm of each L-Key features a ball-end design which allows angle screws to be accessed in confined spaces. In addition, the holding function element securely holds screws, thanks to a clamping effect achieved by a flexible locking ball. Hex-plus profile offers greater surface contact in the head of the screw, reducing the notching effect to a minimum and deformation to the screw head is almost eliminated. High corrosion protection due to BlackLaser surface treatment, with the round bar design adding further strength, particularly for smaller sizes. Thermoplastic sleeve ensures the correct size is easy to recognise and the L-keys are easy to grip even at low temperatures. Wear-resistant clip ensures secure storage of the L-keys as well as simple removal and access.
